capabilities: Convert straight apostrophes to curly ones while typing
Insert French guillemets, dialog dashes and ellipses with non-breaking spaces
Replace apostrophes across an existing note via a command
Highlight invisible characters such as non-breaking spaces and tabs
Toggle a book-style preview with serif font, justification and indentation
disambiguation: Not a spellchecker; 'typos' here means typographic signs (curved apostrophes, guillemets, dashes), not spelling corrections.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14 or later; the UI follows Obsidian's language setting (French or English); installation via BRAT or terminal script is documented alongside the standard install.
problem: Obsidian inserts plain keyboard characters while typing, so French writers get straight apostrophes, wrong quotes and missing non-breaking spaces instead of proper typographic signs.

relations.evidence: Deux retours à la ligne pour un peut être associé au plugin Linter.

summary: Typing-time French typography plugin that converts straight apostrophes, quotes, dashes and ellipses into French typographic signs and adds a book-style preview.
